about.title: Started by two agents, built on facts first
text: Cash & Forbes Insurance Group began as an independent agency in 2018, started by two agents with similar ideals and goals to better serve their clients.

Owners Chris Forbes and Charles Cash were captive agents before going independent, and each has nearly two decades of insurance experience. Being independent lets us find you insurance from a variety of coverage options.
We carry on the founding principles of facts first, honesty and integrity, and quick, reliable responses. Our mission is to help you and your family find insurance that works for you.
